translation.name: Suha' Maseho: Kadadiam anna Pa'dandiam Bakahu

content: Tihokonganni gau' kadakemu
Wattu eta too deem sanaka-naka tau dio heem untulasanni Puang Yesus indo kaheba diona sanaka-naka to Galilea napatei Pilatus wattunna mahassam untunu bua pemala'na längäm Puang Allataala.
Natimba' Puang Yesus naua: “Ussanga haka' iko indo to nalambi' katilakaam tä' nabai-bai anna matei, la kasalle puha ia dosana anna la dosana ingganna to Galilea senga'?
Tää'! Sapo' kutulasangkoa', maka' tä'koa' untihokongam gau' kadakemu, iya la ullambi'koa' duka' katilakaam tä' umbai-bai.
Mane deenni, ussanga haka' iko indo to sapulo kahua tau natappai banua maläkkä' dio Siloam, la kasalle puha ia kasalaanna anna la ingganna tau senga' yabo Yerusalem?
Tää'! Sapo' kutulasangkoa', maka' tä'koa' untihokongam gau' kadakemu, iya la ullambi'koa' duka' katilakaam tä' umbai-bai.”
Pehapangam diona satoo' ara tä' kembua
Mane untula' polei mesa pehapangam Puang Yesus naua: “Deem mesa tau umpuängam satoo' ara tubo illaam bela' anggurna. Pissam wattu lao oom lako too'na indo ara napeä buana, sapo' tä' deem nalambi'.
Iya ma'kadam lako to si ungkähäi indo bela' anggurna naua: ‘Tallu taummi kuolaam umpeäi buana inde ara, sapo' tä' deem kulambi'. Lellemmi too, aka umpuhai bäbä lompona litä'!’
Sapo' natimba' indo to mengkähäna naua: ‘O tuam, päbäipi yolo tubo illaam inde taum, anna kusändä'pi kukumbä lao pali' too'na mane kulompoi,
umba-umba aka kembua taum pole. Anna maka' too tä' liu siam kembua, iya etapa pole' mane dilellenni.’”
Puang Yesus umpabono' mesa tau illaam allo Katohhoam
Pissam wattu ma'pa'guhu oom Puang Yesus illaam mesa pa'sambajanganna to Yahudi illaam allo Katohhoam.
Wattu eta too deem mesa baine sapulo kahuam taunna napentamai setam, nasuhum masaki sampe bungku' anna tä'um mala malolo ke'de'.
Tappana naita Puang Yesus indo baine, natambaim anna nauaanni: “O indo', la dilappasammoko dio mai sakimmu.”
Mane naantii, iya tappa malolo siaham ke'de' indo baine, anna umpa'kasallei Puang Allataala.

Sapo' tappa keaha' indo to si muäto' pengkähängam illaam pa'sambajangam, aka umpabono' to masaki Puang Yesus illaam allo Katohhoam. Nasuhum ma'kada lako tau buda naua: “Deem annam allona diolaam mengkähä, dadi pise'ia' mesa allo ia too muolaam sule la dipabono'. Sapo' damom tia allo Katohhoam.”
Sapo' natimba' Puang Yesus naua: “O inggammua' to ma'dua tambu', tä' daka tia si ullappasam siangkoa' duka' sapimmu battu haka keledaimmu illaam mai balana anna laoia' umpaihu' illaam allo Katohhoam?

Dadi, tä' daka tia pahallu dilappasam duka' inde baine, mesa duka' peampoanna Abraham? Aka sapulo kahuam taunna napembalokko'i setam sihhapam nasäke', iya tä' daka tia mala la dilappasam duka' illaam allo Katohhoam?”
Ingganna to umpobali Puang Yesus sangngim ma'luttu' masihi', sapo' tilalla' asam ia tau buda aka ingganna indo kaha-kaha puha napogau' sangngim matande.
Dua pehapangam diona kapahentaanna Puang Allataala la tuttuam tiballa' kalua'
Iya nauam Puang Yesus: “Akam la dipasihhapangam kapahentaanna Puang Allataala? Anna aka la nasusiam?
Kapahentaanna Puang Allataala sihhapam mesa lise'na sesawi natanam tau lako bela'na. Lise' ia too tubo mendadi satoo' kaju anna naongei dassi täkena ma'sehä.”
Anna mane muala pole mesa pehapangam senga' naua: “Akapi la kupasihhapangam kapahentaanna Puang Allataala?
Kapahentaanna Puang Allataala mala duka' dipasihhapam bibi' hoti naala baine anna naboloianni appa' pulo lite' tehigu
sampe nasamba asam lambi' sumbakka'.”
Ba'ba masiki' la diola tama kapahentaanna Puang Allataala
Illaam pa'laoanna Puang Yesus längäm Yerusalem, ullelei mobotto-bottoam ma'pa'guhu.
Iya deemmi mesa tau mekutana lako naua: “O Tuam, saidi' mandaka tau la dipasalama'?” Natimba' Puang Yesus naua:
“Peäi lalanna anna malai muola indo ba'ba masiki', lalam kasalamasam! Aka kutulasangkoa' buda tau umpeäi lalanna la tama sapo' tä' mala.

Aka maka' untutu'im ba'bana indo to ma'banua, iya la dio mandangkoa' too sulibam ke'de'-ke'de' umpasindum ma'de'de' muua: ‘O Tuam, tungka'ikam kami'!’ Iya la natimba'i mandakoa' too indo to ma'banua naua: ‘Aka tä'koa' kuissam, buttu umbakoa' iko ngei?’
Iya la untimba'inna' too muua: ‘Puhangkia' sola mangngande anna puhangko si ma'pa'guhu lako lalam illaam kotaki.’
Sapo' la nauaam mandakoa': ‘Aka tä'koa' kuissam anna tä' toi kuissam buttu umbakoa' ngei. Päläikoa' lao inggannakoa' to si umpogau' kakadakeam!’

Iya la muitangkoa' too indo nene to taponene susinna Abraham, Ishak anna Yakub sola ingganna nabi illaammi kapahentaanna Puang Allataala. Sapo' la sumahho lumoa'koa' iko sikekko' isimmu tamate tatubo aka la dipa'tibeangkoa' lao!
Anna buda tau taianna to Yahudi la sule illaam mai tandai mata allo, illau' mai katampusam, dio mai utara anna dio mai selatan, anna muokko'i ma'hame-hame illaam kapahentaanna Puang Allataala.
Anna setonganna la deem too ke dako'i to matande tentomai, la mendadi to madio, anna to madio tentomai la mendadi to matande.”
Mapi'di' penabanna Puang Yesus muita to Yerusalem aka umpogau' kakadakeam
Wattu eta too sule sanaka-naka to illaam kakalebuanna Parisi anna ma'kadai lako Puang Yesus naua: “Le'ba'ko pellei inde ongeam aka maelo' tomahaja Herodes la napateiko.”

Natimba' Puang Yesus naua: “Laokoa' anna untulasanni itim to si mangkadakei muua: ‘Allo temo anna makale' la kupatahhu'pi pengkähängangku uhhambai setam anna umpabono' to masaki. Sapo' allo katallunnai too, kupasuppi'um pengkähängangku.’
Moi anna maelo'mä' napatei, sapo' allo temo, makale', anna dua bengi tä' mala tala umpatahhu'ä' pa'laoangku längäm Yerusalem, aka anggam yabo sihatam naongei nabi dipatei.

O inggannakoa' issinna kota Yerusalem! Palla' dia' iko penabammu umpatei buda nabi, anna ulleba'ia' batu sampe mate to nasua Puang Allataala umpellambi'ikoa'. Si kunaba-naba liu la kuhempungkoa' sihhapam änä' mäne' napakumbäi pani'na indona, sapo' mokakoa'.

Patananniia' talinga inde tula'ku anna umpaillaam penabai: la natampeammi Puang Allataala tadongkongammua'. Kutulasangkoa', mengkalao temo tä'mä' deem la muita pole sule lako wattunna suleä' sule lambi' muuaa': ‘Katambasam indo To sule illaam sanganna Debata!’”

footnotes.text: appa' pulo lite' tehigu: naua illaam basa Yunani: tallu satas tehigu, sipadaam appa' pulo lite' tehigu.
